title: ctenopteris cuencana
intro: Ctenopteris cuencana, commonly known as the Ecuadorian polypody, is a species of fern that belongs to the family Polypodiaceae. It is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include providing relief from various health issues such as inflammation, fever, and respiratory problems, due to its numerous health benefits. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and expectorant properties, which aid in soothing irritated tissues and promoting the expulsion of mucus. The bioactive constituents of Ctenopteris cuencana include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
